lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno waited for the moon
To turn bright blue, and very soon!
Kiki yawned, it's late, my friend,
That blue moon wait will never end!
[chorus]
Once in a blue moon, once in a blue moon,
Hardly ever, not very soon!
Once in a blue moon, once in a blue moon,
Rare as a snowman in June!
[verse]
It means a thing that's really rare,
It hardly happens anywhere,
Like when you find a four-leaf clover,
Once in a while, and then it's over!
[chorus]
Once in a blue moon, once in a blue moon,
Hardly ever, not very soon!
Once in a blue moon, once in a blue moon,
Very rare, so hum this tune!
[outro]
So when something's super rare,
Once in a blue moon, it's there!
